# sq-55 — Release docs test rejects unrelated version numbers in current entries

The release docs test (tests/squalify.Cli.Tests/DocsTests.cs, `CurrentChangesLabelProblems`) rejects any x.y.z in a current entry's prose that is above the current Version, so a note like "needs System.Text.Json 10.0.1" under Version 1.0.1 fails with "names 10.0.1, which is newer than 1.0.1". It fails loudly and clearly, and today's entries have no such number. Decide whether to restrict the check to version-shaped mentions of squalify itself.
